erg — a terminal-native, shape-shifting agent.

Usage:
  erg [flags] [prompt]

Flags:
  -p                 one-shot: run one prompt and print the answer (prompt from
                     args or stdin), then exit
  -c                 continue the latest session for this directory
  --resume[=ID]      resume a session (latest, or a specific id)
  --shape NAME       run under a named shape (design-partner, spec-implementer, ...)
  --provider NAME    override the provider (local, openai, anthropic, ...)
  --model NAME       override the model
  --effort LEVEL     override the effort/reasoning level
  --install-manifest install the herdr detection manifest and exit
  --version          print version and exit

Examples:
  erg                                interactive REPL against the local model
  erg -p "list the TODOs"            one prompt, clean stdout
  printf "explain x" | erg -p        prompt from stdin
  erg --shape spec-implementer -p "implement docs/DESIGN.md"
  tail -F telemetry.jsonl | erg --shape telemetry-watcher
